lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: The Blackberry Bush. Peppa and her family are at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
lines.zh: 黑莓丛。佩奇一家在猪奶奶和猪爷爷家。

lines.en: Today, I'm going to make apple and blackberry crumble! Yummy! I need you brave explorers to go and get the fruit!
lines.zh: 今天，我要做苹果黑莓酥！真好吃！我需要你们这些勇敢的探险家去把水果采回来！

lines.en: We've got baskets for the apples and buckets for the blackberries! First, the easy bit: picking apples! On the count of three, shake the tree! One, two...
lines.zh: 我们有装苹果的篮子和装黑莓的桶！首先是简单的部分：摘苹果！数到三，摇树！一、二……

lines.en: Three! Now for the blackberries! Why don't we just have apple crumble? Because blackberries are tasty, too, Grandpa!
lines.zh: 三！现在轮到黑莓了！我们为什么不做纯苹果酥呢？因为黑莓也很好吃呀，爷爷！

lines.en: Okay, now the hard bit! Now that's what I call a blackberry bush! This bush has been here since I was a little piggy! It's an overgrown weed, I should have cut it down years ago!
lines.zh: 好吧，现在是难的部分了！这才配叫黑莓丛呢！我小时候这丛树就在这儿了！它就是一丛疯长的野草，我早该把它砍掉的！

lines.en: Grandpa, why don't you like it? I don't like the way it looks at me! Silly Grandpa, it's just a harmless bush, and it's covered in lovely blackberries!
lines.zh: 爷爷，你为什么不喜欢它？我不喜欢它盯着我的样子！傻爷爷，它只是一丛无害的灌木，而且上面结满了可爱的黑莓呢！

lines.en: George has seen some really big juicy blackberries! Careful, George, or you might get tangled!
lines.zh: 乔治发现了几颗又大又多汁的黑莓！乔治小心点，不然会被缠住的！

lines.en: I have a stick for picking hard-to-reach blackberries! Clever Grandpa! But the best blackberries are right at the very top! That's why I've brought the ladder!
lines.zh: 我有一根棍子，用来摘那些够不到的黑莓！爷爷真聪明！但最好的黑莓在最顶上呢！所以我带了梯子来！

lines.en: Um, don't lean too far over, Mummy Pig! Don't worry, I've been climbing this blackberry bush since I was a little girl! Yes, but you're not a little girl now! I know what I'm doing!
lines.zh: 嗯，猪妈妈，别探得太远！别担心，我从还是小女孩的时候就开始爬这丛黑莓了！是呀，可你现在不是小女孩了呀！我知道自己在做什么！

lines.en: Oh, dear, Mummy Pig has fallen into the blackberry bush! Mummy, can you get out? Uh, no, I'm stuck! You're stuck in a thorny bush, like Sleeping Beauty!
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，猪妈妈掉进黑莓丛里了！妈妈，你能出来吗？呃，不行，我卡住了！你卡在一丛带刺的灌木里，就像睡美人一样！

lines.en: What? Once upon a time, there was a princess called Sleeping Beauty! One day, she fell asleep in a thorny bush, and she stayed there for a hundred years! Yes, that's a nice story, Peppa!
lines.zh: 什么？很久很久以前，有一位公主叫睡美人！有一天，她在一丛带刺的灌木里睡着了，在那里待了一百年！嗯，佩奇，这故事真不错！

lines.en: It is Susie Sheep! Hello, Peppa! Hello, Susie! My mummy is in a blackberry bush, and she'll be there for a hundred years, like Sleeping Beauty! And she'll be rescued by a handsome prince who will give her a kiss!
lines.zh: 是小羊苏西！你好，佩奇！你好，苏西！我妈妈在黑莓丛里，她要在那儿待一百年，就像睡美人一样！而且会有一位英俊的王子来救她，还会给她一个吻！

lines.en: My mummy is having an adventure! I wish my mummy would have adventures like that!
lines.zh: 我妈妈正在经历一场冒险呢！我希望我妈妈也能有这样的冒险！

lines.en: Um, can someone think of a way to get me out of here? Don't worry, Mummy, in a hundred years a handsome prince will rescue you!
lines.zh: 呃，有人能想个办法把我弄出去吗？别担心，妈妈，一百年后会有一位英俊的王子来救你的！

lines.en: I'll be that handsome prince! Grandpa Pig, may I borrow your pruning shears, please? Of course you may, Brave Sir Daddy Pig! Stand back, everyone! Take that, you thorny bush! Take that! Ooh! Yeeow!
lines.zh: 我就是那位英俊的王子！猪爷爷，能把你的修枝剪借给我吗？当然可以，勇敢的猪爸爸爵士！大家退后！看招，你这带刺的灌木！看招！哎哟！哎哟喂！

lines.en: Oh, my prince! My princess! You were meant to stay in there for a hundred years! That was quite long enough! Thank you!
lines.zh: 哦，我的王子！我的公主！你本该在里面待上一百年的！那已经够久了！谢谢你！

lines.en: Mummy was a blackberry bush! I thought this sort of thing only happened to me! Stand still while we pick you!
lines.zh: 妈妈变成黑莓丛啦！我还以为这种事只会发生在我身上呢！你站着别动，我们把黑莓摘下来！

lines.en: Let's take all this fruit back to Granny Pig! Granny! Granny! Mummy had an adventure!
lines.zh: 我们把这些水果都带回去给猪奶奶吧！奶奶！奶奶！妈妈经历了一场冒险！

lines.en: And then Mummy fell in the bush! She looked quite silly, and she was going, "Ah! Help me! Help me!" And then Daddy came and rescued her! The end!
lines.zh: 然后妈妈掉进了灌木丛里！她看起来傻乎乎的，还一直喊着「啊！救命！救命！」然后爸爸来把她救了出来！故事讲完啦！

lines.en: Thank you, Peppa, I think we've all heard that story enough times now! But it's funny!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，佩奇，我觉得这个故事我们已经听得够多啦！不过确实挺好笑的！

lines.en: I never want to see another blackberry in my life! So you don't want any apple and blackberry crumble, then? Well... mmm, delicious!
lines.zh: 我这辈子都不想再看见黑莓了！那你是不想要苹果黑莓酥喽？嗯……嗯，真好吃！

lines.en: Mummy Pig loves apple and blackberry crumble! Everyone loves apple and blackberry crumble!
lines.zh: 猪妈妈喜欢苹果黑莓酥！大家都喜欢苹果黑莓酥！
